items.title: Wasmtime now supports GC and exceptions
items.oneliner: Wasmtime 47 runs GC languages and native exceptions by default, cutting wasm runtime hacks and shrinking embedded collectors.

items.title: Postgres notifications can handle real load
items.oneliner: Hands-on scaling guide shows LISTEN/NOTIFY reaching 60,000 writes per second with low latency and fewer polling loops.

items.title: Practical notes for running SQLite well
items.oneliner: Clear SQLite walkthrough covers indexing, errors, and operational gotchas that matter once your toy database becomes production.

items.title: Fedora build pipeline explained end to end
items.oneliner: Detailed walkthrough shows how fedpkg and Koji turn source into Fedora artifacts, useful for release engineering and packaging.

items.title: Turn handwriting photos into TTF fonts

items.title: The Stack v3 code dataset is downloadable

items.title: ARC-AGI leaderboard helps compare reasoning systems
